name: Adachi Tenka
source: A girl who has recently moved from the city due to her parents' circumstances. She claims she isn't lonely, while in reality she is, and doesn't get along with [url=/c29522]Chie[/url] who often tries to interact with her. Tenka admires idols a lot and thus, comes often to the candy store to buy idol cards. She calls the protagonist "oji-san".
